headline: Fronts Register Fresh Shifts in Base Control
war_summary: Since the last edition, Mooring County has swung further toward Colonial control: its tally is now eight Colonial, four Warden and no neutral bases, against six, five and one previously. The ledger records 55 base events in 24 hours, including 16 in six and three in the latest two. Linn Mercy has changed from ten Colonial and one neutral to nine Colonial, one Warden and one neutral; five events came in its latest two hours, 34 over the day. Weathered Expanse now lists two Warden, three Colonial and four neutral bases, with 37 events in 24 hours but none in the latest two. Callum’s Cape stands five Colonial to two Warden; its base ledger shows 28 daily events, five in six hours. Marban Hollow now lists four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral base, versus three, three and two last edition; it logged 12 events in 24 hours, none in the latest two. Stlican Shelf has been quieter, with no base events in six hours. The war remains undecided, with 34 victory towns required.
